goal: Fix verdict uniformity in signal_analyser. Currently >95% of all MCPs receive TRUSTED_RESEARCH verdict with scores 65-73. Diagnose why 5 of 6 signals return a single distinct value across all MCPs, then implement signal differentiation. Signals must draw from real observable data: TLS certificate validity, domain age, GitHub star count, OTX threat intel hit, tool count from manifest, and known-bad pattern matching. Each signal should produce meaningful variance across the MCP population.
constraints: Read current signal_analyser at /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/signal_analyser.py before writing
New scoring must produce at least 4 distinct verdicts across a 100-MCP test batch
Thresholds: score <30 = BLOCKED, 30-50 = HIGH_RISK, 50-70 = REVIEW, 70-85 = TRUSTED_RESEARCH, >85 = TRUSTED
success_criteria: signal_analyser log shows mixed verdicts within 1 cycle
At least 3 distinct verdict types in any 50-MCP window
No single verdict >70% of output in any 100-MCP batch
error_handling: Fall back to REVIEW verdict if any signal fetch fails, never emit NULL scores
